newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-PORTUGUESA BEAT GREMIO 2-0 IN FIRST LEG OF BRAZIL FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGUESA BEAT GREMIO 2-0 IN FIRST LEG OF BRAZIL FINAL.

text.p: Portuguesa beat Gremio 2-0 (halftime 1-0) in the first leg of the Brazilian championship final on Wednesday.
Second leg to be played on December 15.
Note: Portuguesa were playing at home.
Aggregate score will decide the winner. If the aggregate score is level after Sunday's match, Gremio will take the title on having the better overall record in the competition.
